en.title: Download a Sea Surface Temperature Product
en.description:
This function downloads one of the sea surface temperature (SST) products listed by
`fao_sst_products()`, one year at a time, and computes the yearly SST of each FAO major marine
fishing area (see `fao_area_sst()` for the method). The product can then be used by its name,
e.g. `fao_area_sst(sst = "hadisst1")`, `mean_temperature_catch(..., sst = "hadisst1")` or
`fao_settings(sst = "hadisst1")`. Files are kept in the `sst` folder of `data_dir`, with
`files.csv` recording where and when each was downloaded; years already downloaded are skipped,
so an interrupted download can be resumed by running the function again. For ERSST v5, whose
table is built into the package, the function adds the years published since.
en.details:
SST data from other sources can be used without this function, by giving the path of the
NetCDF files (see `fao_area_sst()`). Reading the files needs the ncdf4 package.
en.value: Invisibly, the area table (as returned by `fao_area_sst()`).

arguments.years:
The years to download. Default is NULL: from 1950 (1982 for OISST v2.1) to the
last complete year.
arguments.data_dir: The directory where downloaded data is stored. Default is `fao_data_dir()`.
arguments.overwrite:
A logical value. If TRUE, years already downloaded are downloaded again.
Default is FALSE.
arguments.quiet: A logical value. If TRUE, progress messages are not printed. Default is FALSE.

zh.title: 下载海表温度数据产品
zh.description: 本函数逐年下载`fao_sst_products()`所列的某一种海表温度（SST）数据产品，并计算每个FAO主要海洋渔区的逐年SST（方法见`fao_area_sst()`）。之后即可按名称使用该产品，例如`fao_area_sst(sst = "hadisst1")`、`mean_temperature_catch(..., sst = "hadisst1")`或`fao_settings(sst = "hadisst1")`。文件保存在`data_dir`的`sst`文件夹中，`files.csv`记录了每个文件的下载地址和下载时间；已下载的年份会跳过，所以下载中断后，重新运行本函数即可接着下载。对于ERSST v5（其数据表已随包提供），本函数用于补充此后新发布的年份：下载的年份替换包内自带数据表中的相同年份，其余年份仍使用包内自带的数据。
zh.details: 不使用本函数，也可以使用其他来源的SST数据，只需给出NetCDF文件的路径（见`fao_area_sst()`）。读取这些文件需要ncdf4包。
zh.value: 以不可见方式返回渔区数据表（与`fao_area_sst()`返回的相同）。

arguments.years: 要下载的年份。默认为NULL：从1950年（OISST v2.1为1982年）到最近一个完整年份。
arguments.data_dir: 下载数据的保存目录。默认为`fao_data_dir()`。
arguments.overwrite: 逻辑值。为TRUE时，已下载的年份会重新下载。默认为FALSE。
arguments.quiet: 逻辑值。为TRUE时不显示进度信息。默认为FALSE。
